name: Masquerade & Co
blurb: Costumes and accessories packed the same day, from a single cape to a full character set.

name: Thread & Timber
blurb: Fabric, felt, cord and planters cut to length and posted to your door with care.

name: Pin & Solder
blurb: Boards, sensors and small 3D-printed parts for weekend makers, with wiring notes in every box.

name: Dalston Party Store
blurb: Balloons, fancy dress and last-minute costume bits on the high street since 1998.

name: Hackney Fabric House
blurb: Rolls of satin, felt and ribbon cut to order, with advice from people who actually sew.

name: Kingsland Garden Centre
blurb: Pots, peat-free compost and seedlings, plus honest advice on what grows on a London windowsill.

name: Broadway Market Hardware
blurb: Cord, tubs, screws and tools sold by the single item, so you only buy what the job needs.

name: Mare Street Makers
blurb: A maker space shop selling sensors, boards and filament, with a shared bench on Saturdays.

name: Camden Costume Cupboard
blurb: Wigs, masks and hire costumes in a basement a few doors from the lock.

name: Bellenden Plant Shed
blurb: A tiny plant shop with herbs, troughs and a watering-can refill bar out the back.

name: Nest & Shelf
blurb: Boxes, baskets and shelf fittings for small London homes, sent flat to save space.

name: Mare Street Charity Shop
blurb: Donated baskets, boxes and homeware, cleaned by volunteers and priced to find a second home.
